facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: uncontrolled movement of G-8103 during a breakdown response

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on G-8103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. G-8103 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 December 2011 an incident occurred on G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
